name: How do I choose the right type of marble for my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right type of marble for my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right marble involves considering several factors: color palette, veining patterns, and finish. Lighter marbles like Carrara or Calacatta offer a classic, bright look, while darker varieties provide a more dramatic effect. Veining can range from subtle to bold, impacting the overall design. Finishes include polished (glossy, reflective) or honed (matte, less slippery). Consider the bathroom's existing decor, lighting, and your personal aesthetic preferences. We can help guide you through samples to find the best fit for your space and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider color, veining, and finish (polished or honed) when selecting marble. Match it to your bathroom's decor and lighting, and consult with professionals to find the best option.
